'''Desvin Tor'thal''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
The pirate band Tor'thal was part of once worked for the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]]. However, Rystra captured Tor'thal and some of the other pirates and took them back to the [[Temple of Pain]], a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] built inside an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. Rystra practiced [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] on them and Tor'thal's [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] were altered to give them poison glands, that secreted [[Sith poison]]. This could be fired from [[stinger]]s that were also attached to them.
